name: DAAD Scholarship Database

extractionHints.detail: Detail pages are strongly fielded with '### ' headings — Target Group, Academic Requirements, Number of Scholarships, Duration, Scholarship Value, Application Requirements, Application Deadline. A deterministic parser should handle most fields; the LLM is only needed for prose eligibility. Every page is prefixed by a cookie-consent block that must be stripped before extraction.
extractionHints.applicability: DAAD scholarships name no specific university — they state rules like 'state or state-recognised universities in Germany'. Capture these as applicability rules, not as host institutions.

notes: GO/NO-GO HISTORY. 2026-08-10: FAILED — plain curl timed out and a Crawl4AI attempt against both the listing page and the bare domain root timed out completely (45s, Page.goto never reached domcontentloaded), diagnosed as a network-level block from that environment. Source was PAUSED and Germany coverage fell back to TU Berlin. 2026-09-05: RE-VERIFIED AND REACTIVATED — curl returns 200 for both www.daad.de and www2.daad.de, and crucially the real Playwright path was re-tested end-to-end (success=True, HTTP 200, 16,373 chars of markdown with full Target Group / Duration / Scholarship Value content). The earlier block is gone. Discovery switched from link-following to sitemap: the scholarship database is a faceted search app with no crawlable listing, but www2.daad.de/sitemap.xml enumerates every detail page. IMPORTANT: <loc> carries the GERMAN page (/de/21148-stipendiendatenbank/) and the English page is only reachable via <xhtml:link hreflang="en"> — hence the /en/ sitemapUrlPattern, which resolves exactly 149 English scholarships (259 German detail pages exist; 110 have no English version). robots.txt declares Crawl-delay: 2 (honoured via rateLimitMs) and disallows /pdf/, so linked PDF announcements are excluded.
